text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Cute Curren Chan! Cute Curren Chan! Cute 
Curren Chan...—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a truly breathtaking sight. 
Everyone present was showering the newly 
crowned queen with praise...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Everyone...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you all for your support♪ Thank you 
for loving Curren~♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren's cuteness made you happy, didn't 
it♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The most innocent smile she had ever 
shown. Now that she had reached the 
pinnacle, she was finally content...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Gnnnnnghhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I. Have. Lost!!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Aha, I won~♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Nuwaaaaah!? Kicking me while smiling?! 
That's so frustratiiiing!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, whoa there. We all share the same 
regret, yes!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Still, that beautiful race... it was so 
much fun, yes?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! Out of all the races we've run 
so far, that one was super exciting~.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
It really became quite a hot topic with 
the “Cute Derby♪”, after all~.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure way more people are going to 
start watching sprint races from now on♪"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I see~. That's why Curren-chan has such a 
wonderful look on her face.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
It's not just because we won. At least, 
that's how it feels to me... Am I wrong?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm, I wonder? Though if there's one 
thing I can say—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Maybe it means... being "cute" is truly 
wonderful♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Well then, Curren will be going now♪ 
—Because I want to share these feelings 
right this second!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Big Bro~~ther!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Big siiis~!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hey, Curren—
choice_data_list: You were super cute out there!
You were super cute out there!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Big Brother, I love you~♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I love you so much, big sis~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Curren Chan's follower count skyrocketed 
that day. Her post-race comment racked up 
so many "Likes" that stacked together, 
they'd reach beyond the galaxy—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Sweeping the #1 trending spot worldwide 
across all social media. The winner of the 
final 'Kawaii Derby♪' was crystal clear to 
everyone..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Curren Chan became... the most 
beloved Umamusume of all!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
—Still, I wonder who loves you the 
deeeeepest...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren understands com~pletely, okay? 
...Onii-chan♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren understands com~pletely, okay? 
...Onee-chan♪
